question: Is impurity a separate tattva like attachment?
premises: mere fitness only, this, for to-be-limited summary
by that impurity of this, no separate-reality-state exists
inference: Impurity is mere fitness-condition, no separate tattva — as with raga.
plain_english: Mere fitness only, this, for to-be-limited summary — by that impurity of this, no separate-reality-state exists, like attachment.
